name: Dataset for: Efficacy of combined orthokeratology and 0.01% atropine solution for slowing axial elongation in children with myopia: a 2-year randomised trial
description: This dataset file contains the pertinent data including age, sex, spherical equivalent refraction, axial length, corneal endothelial cell density, intraocular pressure, uncorrected distant and near visual acuity, and compliance rate of subjects who completed the 2-year study in the orthokeratology and 0.01% atropine combination group and the orthokeratology monotherapy group.
